Requirement: 1200 units from one supplier, delivery <= 30 days.

Step 1 - Qualification check:
- Alpha: max 1700 >= 1200 PASS, 18 days <= 30 PASS => qualifies
- Bravo: max 1000 < 1200 FAIL, 10 days <= 30 PASS => disqualified for quantity
- Cobalt: max 2400 >= 1200 PASS, 35 days > 30 FAIL => disqualified for deadline

Only Alpha meets both quantity and deadline.

Step 2 - Total landed cost for Alpha:
Goods = 11.91 EUR * 1200 = 14292.00 EUR
Goods in USD = 14292.00 * 1.08 = 15435.36 USD
Goods + shipping = 15435.36 + 600.00 = 16035.36 USD
Duty = 8% * 16035.36 = 1282.8288 USD
Total = 16035.36 + 1282.8288 = 17318.1888 USD = 17318.19 USD rounded

Bravo and Cobalt are cheaper in theory but do not qualify, so cannot be chosen.

Choice is Alpha at 17318.19 USD.
{"choice": "Alpha", "value": 17318.19}
